name: Mordrath
loreTies: Source: Horns/wings/claws (rank, predation, nobility, monstrous majesty)
shortBackstory: Mordrath is the infernal sovereign defender — the Horns-source whose authority is predation refined into law. He protects through the threat of what he will do to anything that crosses him.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Mordrath was born from the predator's throne — authority that comes from being the last thing standing. He is the defender whose power is predation refined into law. Ancient humans saw demon kings — but they saw the horns and missed the crown. His horns are rank, earned through being the last thing standing in a room where everything tried to be.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Infernal Dominion, Mordrath is the reason the faction has a boundary. His sovereign-predator authority means entering his territory costs more than anything you could gain. He defends through the certainty that crossing him has consequences.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Mordrath by making his predation meaningless. The Hollow removes prey — and a predator with nothing to predate is not a sovereign; he is just a large being in an empty room.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In Cinders of Dominion, Mordrath's sovereign-predator authority creates zones of infernal law. His iron-horned crown-armor absorbs attacks and converts them into threat-aura. But the Hollow removes the enemies his authority threatens.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Mordrath's flaw is that he has never known whether his authority comes from respect or fear. The Hollow teaches him that a sovereign whose authority is fear may find that fear, like prey, can be erased — and the sovereign who never earned respect has nothing when fear runs out.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
